description:
Calculate sample min/max, unweighted mean and start-to-end change from Weirdgloop daily prices. Use get_price_series for raw observations or UTC date bounds, and get_item_details for catalogue detail.

itemId skips name resolution; name resolves first. days selects trailing usable samples from a fixed 90-day fetch, not a fetch-size or calendar-date control. Fewer available samples reduce windowDays.

No usable history returns an error; results are historical statistics, not forecasts.

Daily history lags live offers. Reads are uncached and require no credentials. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.

days.description: Size of the trailing window in days (7-90, default 30)

itemId.description: Grand Exchange item ID (provide itemId or name)

name: summarize_price_history

avgDailyVolume.description: Unweighted mean of reported daily volumes, rounded to a whole number; unreported values are excluded

avgPrice.description: Average price in the window, rounded to whole coins

changePct.description: Percent change across the window, rounded to two decimals; 0 when the oldest price is 0

latestPrice.description: Newest price in the window, in coins

maxPrice.description: Highest price in the window, in coins

minPrice.description: Lowest price in the window, in coins

name.description: Name supplied by the caller, when given

oldestPriceInWindow.description: Oldest price in the window, in coins

title: Summarize Daily Price Statistics
